dedupe_keys.name: mineralogy geochemistry and environmental hazards of different types of mining waste from a former mediterranean metal mining area

description: Gregorio García Fernández at Universidad Politécnica de Cartagena publishes a workbook supporting mineralogical and geochemical assessment of mining waste in southeastern Spain. The associated Land study characterises seven mining-waste settings in the Cartagena–La Unión area and an agricultural control soil, using mineralogical, elemental and leaching measurements. The freely available Zenodo workbook is licensed CC BY 4.0. These observations can inform contaminant-release assumptions and calibration of mine-waste or reclamation simulations. Coverage consists of selected surface composite samples, not a complete inventory of tailings deposits or a continuous monitoring network. No related catalogue record explicitly covers these measurements. The repository’s malformed article DOI contains an extra space; the resolved primary citation is recorded separately. Sample dates, workbook units, analytical uncertainty and field-to-laboratory transfer remain unverified. The workbook itself was not downloaded, and reported hazard classifications were not independently reassessed.
